messages:
Maya Patel: Quick syncneed a tight slice for the 'Optimize toolkit' work. Customers keep asking for actionable batching/caching guidance, quant recommendations, and eval-triggered alerts. Proposal: small alpha we can ship in 2 weeks that is pilot-only.

Cameron Lee: Rough dev estimates: batching heuristics + tiny UI = 5d, eval-alerts alpha = 4d, quant recs (advice only, no automatic quant) = 6d. We should pick two.

Priya Singh: Design: ship compact UX. One-pane control: toggle recommendations, preview expected cost/latency delta, and an alerts card with last-run snapshot. Keep copy minimal.

Juan Alvarez: Acceptance criteria suggestion for alpha: 1) Batching: implement 2 heuristics (seq-based dynamic batch size, prefix cache boosting), expose per-route toggle, and show simulated cost/latency impact. 2) Eval-alerts: allow on-demand run + one scheduled run, surface diff + hit list, create audit log entry. 3) Pilot gating: opt-in only; integrate KMS-compatible audit payloads for FinCo.

Oliver Nash: Ops constraints: alpha must be rate-limited per-tenant. No continuous background jobs across all tenants. We'll gate scheduled runs to pilot tenants and add a per-tenant circuit-breaker. Also need a canary job for the profiler.

Maya Patel: Agreed. Proposed sprint slice: (A) Batching UI + backend heuristics (MVP) (B) Eval-alerts alpha behind opt-in; quant recs postponed to next sprint. Anyone opposed?

Cameron Lee: +1. Heuristics: restrict to two rules to keep runtime simple. Backend will expose a /v1/admin/batching/simulate endpoint for the UI to call.

Priya Singh: UX note: the simulated estimate can be based on the offline profiler. We'll annotate that it's an estimate. Microcopy: "Estimated - tokens saved / median latency change".

Juan Alvarez: Pilot customers: ACME (low-volume) and FinCo (mid-volume + compliance). ACME for cost feedback, FinCo for audit/KMS checks. Set alert threshold default to 4% top-1 drop, adjustable by pilot.

Maya Patel: I'll issue invites and draft docs. Draft acceptance checklist below: 
- Batching: UI toggle + 2 heuristics + simulate endpoint + unit tests + perf benchmark showing <=10% median latency regression and measurable token-cost improvement in synthetic harness.
- Eval-alerts: rule editor (Y/N), on-demand run, one scheduled run for pilots, dashboard diff view, audit log entry, opt-in flag.
- Docs: quickstart + SDK snippet for toggling.

Cameron Lee: Dev checklist: PRs with unit tests, e2e that runs small synthetic workload, a short perf harness under tools/profiler/, and a canary pipeline job. I'll prototype heuristics on a branch `feat/optimize-proto`.

Oliver Nash: Ops tasks: add tenant quota guard, document rollback steps, add circuit-breaker config. I'll create a playbook card and a rollback script snippet.

Priya Singh: UI label: "Inference Guidance (alpha)" with tooltip: "Automated batching & cache suggestions; eval alerts for regressions". Keep it unobtrusive.

Juan Alvarez: Example alert config for docs:
```
alerts:
  - name: regression-smoke
    prompt_set: acme_core_v1
    metric: top1_accuracy
    threshold: -0.04
    schedule: daily
```

Maya Patel: Release-bot, run CI for the protos?

release-bot: CI status 00% tests passed on `feat/optimize-proto`, perf/quick-check flaky, rerun scheduled.

Maya Patel: OK next steps: Maya -> pilot invites & docs; Cameron -> heuristics prototype + simulate endpoint; Priya -> UI wires + microcopy; Oliver -> ops runbook & quota guard; Juan -> prompt sets + metrics. Kickoff tomorrow 10am, 30m. Reconvene 24h after kickoff. :thumbsup:
